purpose: Random-cast end-to-end conversations plus isolated replay of history organization; not a new formal 40+40 benchmark.
development: Two previously seen three-turn question chains, freshly random production casts; no selection or reroll.
probe: Four captured follow-up requests, role-only and background/native-turn variants. Same generation configuration and evidence, no repair; baseline originals retained.
holdout: Six unseen independent-agent three-turn scenarios; read only after candidate decision. Random cast through API per session. No outcome-based reruns.
decision: Read all probe outputs with independent reviewer. Adopt a small context change only when it materially helps progression without sacrificing fact/quote boundaries. Preserve negative outcomes.

price.basis: Weekend off-peak Flash per million tokens

boundaries: No new writing templates, no polish agent; classical meaning separately reviewed, no expert Gold claim.
